Shell(cd apps/mobile && nohup npx expo start --port 8081 > /tmp/expo-bundle3.log 2>&1 & sleep 10 # Get manifest first to get the right bundle URL MANIFEST=$(curl -s -m 10 -H "expo-platform: android" "http://localhost:8081/" 2>&1) echo "---manifest mainModuleName---" echo "$MANIFEST" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['launchAsset']['url']); print('extra.expoClient.main:', d.get('extra',{}).get('expoClient',{}).get('main'))" 2>&1 | head -5 # request bundle from manifest URL (normalize localhost) BUNDLE_URL=$(echo "$MANIFEST" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['launchAsset']['url'].replace('127.0.0.1','localhost'))" 2>&1) echo "---bundle url---"; echo "$BUNDLE_URL" | head -3 curl -s -m 180 "$BUNDLE_URL" -o /tmp/bundle3.js 2>&1 echo "BUNDLE3_SIZE:$(wc -c < /tmp/bundle3.js)" head -c 200 /tmp/bundle3.js; echo "" tail -12 /tmp/expo-bundle3.log pkill -f "expo start" 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned)
